name: PokeSurvive
description: A survival roguelike overhaul with randomized runs, survival meters, moods, camping, permadeath options, Adventure Events, and more.

name: Angler's Cove Aquarium
description: A fishing and aquarium expansion. Catch aquatic Pokémon, raise them in a living tank, care for them, and show off unusual catches.

name: Safari Derby
description: Transforms Fuchsia City's Safari Zone into a Pokémon racing and wagering side activity with player-entered racers and spectator events.

name: Mutant Monster Lab
description: Restore a deeply questionable Cinnabar research facility and splice Pokémon together while managing increasingly unstable mutations.

name: Battle Factory Remix
description: A Battle Factory expansion built around rental teams, battle streaks, swapping Pokémon after wins, and special rewards.

name: Spirit Wardens
description: A paranormal investigation expansion built around hauntings, evidence, cursed objects, escalating activity, and surviving what you uncover.
